title: Arrears Restriction on an Employee Meal Account
content:
Payroll tender is switched off on an Employee Meal Account once the charges awaiting recovery pass the restriction threshold printed against the plan and the grace days printed against the same plan have gone by without the balance coming down.

## What a restriction does and does not do

A restricted account keeps its stored value and its allowance and may go on eating; only the payroll tender is withdrawn, and the badge is not blocked.

## The state the account must stand in

A restriction or a reinstatement is only worked while the account stands active or restricted, since a parked, enrolled or closed account has no payroll tender to switch. The account's own record settles this before the restriction or the reinstatement is worked, read by the account's reference together with the charges awaiting recovery and the day any restriction began.

## Lifting a restriction

The restriction is lifted once the employee has paid down at least the share of the outstanding arrears printed against their plan, whether by loading value, by a one-off payment or by a payroll period clearing. **That clause is no longer in force**: what the employee must pay in before a restriction is lifted is settled on the current basis for working that figure out, and this document does not restate it.

Where the plan requires the whole balance paid, a part payment does not lift the restriction however large it is, and the employee is told exactly what remains.

## A restriction applied in error

A restriction applied in error is lifted at once and no charge falls due, and any meal declined for payroll while it stood may be rung again on the ordinary tender order.

## More than one account

Where an employee holds more than one account under the same employer, the arrears measured against the threshold are the portfolio total rather than the single account's.

## Points of judgement

| What the records show | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Charges awaiting recovery above the printed threshold, grace days gone by, balance not come down | Payroll tender is switched off |
| Charges above the threshold but the printed grace days not yet gone by | The restriction does not yet apply |
| The account parked for leave, enrolled or closed | Neither a restriction nor a reinstatement is worked on it |
| A restriction found to have been applied in error | It is lifted at once and no charge falls due |

superseded_clauses: The restriction is lifted once the employee has paid down at least the share of the outstanding arrears printed against their plan, whether by loading value, by a one-off payment or by a payroll period clearing.
